How long ago was the world built?  I get the impression that it existed well before the SotM game was bring written.

What was the initial motivation for creating the SotM world?  Was there originally plans to create a comic universe to tell/publish stories in?  Was it for a superhero RPG?  Or was it world building for the sake of world building?

posts.cooked:
For fun. Its Adam and Christophers private comic book world. Just made for fun, and SotM was made to play in that world, for fun. Then Paul showed up with a business plan and said "You could do this for a living!" and they are.

 

At least, thats the impression ive gotten from listening to Christopher talk about it.

posts.name: UXM266
posts.cooked:
What I love about their world is that they show so much love to the every kind of comic book style, every character is either a loving homage to a popular character or a complete. The tongue-in-cheek humor, the shout-outs, and charm of the characters make the game so intriguing. 

To me the universe is more of a love letter to 75ish years of work done by 1000s of creators. I especially love that how much time was planned out since the original release those years ago! I love how gigantic this thing getting, it's as though they are bringing the power the wrath of the cosmos upon us! I am always caught of guard how much is planned, from card art being in used in the original edition only being shown in Vengeance! I am alays surprised, and just love everything they plan out. 

TL;DR: Essentially, Greater Than Games, you guys are totally kickass!
